title: perf(state): skip unchanged scalar writes and resolve stale computed vars lazily
author: FarhanAliRaza

unresolved.first_comment: P1 Failed recomputation loses stale state: when a stale computed getter raises, _resolve_stale has already removed its stale marker while leaving the old cache intact.

P1 Keep dynamically added dependencies in the forward map: add_dependency() after class init updates _var_dependencies but not _computed_var_deps, so a write to the added dependency never recomputes it.
P2 Skip dependencies already resolved from the stale snapshot: a dependent resolved before its dependency causes the getter to run twice, defeating the optimization.
P2 Preserve the sign when comparing zero-valued floats: 0.0 == -0.0 so assigning one over the other now returns early and a computed var changing only between these values keeps its stale cache.
P1 duplicate of the add_dependency forward-map finding.
P2 duplicate of the failed-recomputation-loses-stale-state finding.
